## Checklist

- [ ] Each commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [DCO](https://github.com/Hand-Lock/guidonica/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-11).
- [ ] I license this contribution under the MIT License, as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Hand-Lock/guidonica/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#licensing-of-contributions).
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] Each commit adds its entry to `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]`.
- [ ] An ADR is added or updated, if this is an architectural change.
- [ ] Every locale is updated, if UI text changed.
